blog.title: How quantum circuits can mitigate the tragedy of the commons
blog.description: I explore whether a quantum circuit can generate the institution that keeps two islands from overfishing the ground they share — what the entanglement changes, what it recovers from economics, and what it leaves untouched.

Each island has its own small fleet of fishing boats, initially heading independently toward the same rich patch of ocean. Beneath and between the islands, the water subtly transforms into an elegant abstract quantum circuit: two parallel paths representing the two players become coupled through a beautiful symmetric entangling structure, then separate again toward the islands. The quantum circuit should feel like an invisible mechanism underneath the physical world, not a literal computer. Show the shared resource and the coupling between the players as the central visual idea. Clean, spacious, intellectually curious, realistic landscape combined with restrained scientific abstraction, deep ocean, crisp geometry, no text, no labels, no equations, no futuristic clichés, no glowing blue sci-fi computer, editorial scientific illustration, calm and understated, visually explaining an economic mechanism rather than decorating it."
